stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出全人工髖關節置換的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Total hip arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：前側／後外側路徑、髖臼杯角度（Lewinnek 安全區）、股骨柄固定與腿長平衡。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Anterior/posterolateral approaches, cup orientation (Lewinnek), stem fixation and leg-length balancing.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 顯露完成。
臼杯角度正確且穩定。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Exposure complete.
Cup angles correct and stable.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依全人工髖關節置換的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Total hip arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 全人工髖關節置換的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Total hip arthroplasty.

steps.title: 入路與顯露（後外側）
steps.objective: 顯露髖關節並脫臼股骨頭。
steps.objectiveEn: Expose the hip and dislocate the head.
steps.instruction: 側臥固定骨盆；切開闊筋膜與臀大肌，保護坐骨神經，切斷短外旋肌與後關節囊（標記以便修補），內旋脫臼。
steps.instructionEn: Lateral decubitus with pelvis fixed; split fascia lata and gluteus maximus, protect the sciatic nerve, divide short external rotators and posterior capsule (tag for repair), dislocate by internal rotation.
steps.observation: 確認坐骨神經受保護。
steps.observationEn: Confirm sciatic protection.
steps.failure: 過度牽拉坐骨神經造成足下垂。
steps.failureEn: Sciatic traction causes foot drop.
steps.check: 顯露完成。
steps.checkEn: Exposure complete.

knowledge.title: 直接前側入路
knowledge.text: 肌肉間隙入路、脫臼率低但股骨顯露較難。
knowledge.textEn: Internervous plane with low dislocation but harder femoral exposure.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露（後外側）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure (posterolateral)'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
顯露完成。
穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
關閉完成。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Exposure complete.
Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Closure complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 股骨頸切骨
steps.objective: 依術前計畫切除股骨頸。
steps.objectiveEn: Resect the neck as templated.
steps.instruction: 小轉子上方約 10–15 mm（依模板）以 45° 切骨；取出股骨頭並量測直徑。
steps.instructionEn: About 10–15 mm above the lesser trochanter (per template) at 45°; remove the head and measure its diameter.
steps.observation: 記錄切骨高度。
steps.observationEn: Record the cut level.
steps.failure: 切太低縮短腿長並影響柄的穩定。
steps.failureEn: Too low a cut shortens the leg and compromises stem stability.
steps.check: 切骨與計畫一致。
steps.checkEn: Cut matches the plan.

knowledge.title: 術前模板
knowledge.text: 數位模板預估杯／柄尺寸、偏距與腿長。
knowledge.textEn: Digital templating predicts cup/stem size, offset and leg length.

quiz.question: 「股骨頸切骨」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Femoral neck osteotomy'?
options: 切骨與計畫一致。
臼杯角度正確且穩定。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
顯露完成。
optionsEn: Cut matches the plan.
Cup angles correct and stable.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Exposure complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 髖臼磨銼與臼杯置入
steps.objective: 磨銼至出血骨並置入臼杯於安全區。
steps.objectiveEn: Ream to bleeding bone and seat the cup in the safe zone.
steps.instruction: 由小到大同心磨銼至髖臼底軟骨下骨；臼杯外展 40±10°、前傾 15±10°（Lewinnek），壓配 1–2 mm，必要時加螺釘。
steps.instructionEn: Ream concentrically up to subchondral bone at the floor; cup abduction 40±10°, anteversion 15±10° (Lewinnek), 1–2 mm press-fit, screws if needed.
steps.observation: 確認臼杯穩定、骨緣覆蓋 > 70%。
steps.observationEn: Confirm stability and > 70% rim coverage.
steps.failure: 臼杯過度外展增加脫臼與磨損。
steps.failureEn: Excess abduction increases dislocation and wear.
steps.check: 臼杯角度正確且穩定。
steps.checkEn: Cup angles correct and stable.

knowledge.title: 脊椎骨盆關係
knowledge.text: 脊椎僵硬者需調整臼杯目標。
knowledge.textEn: Stiff spines require adjusted cup targets.

quiz.question: 「髖臼磨銼與臼杯置入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Acetabular reaming and cup placement'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
顯露完成。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
臼杯角度正確且穩定。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Exposure complete.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
Cup angles correct and stable.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 股骨髓腔準備與柄置入
steps.objective: 準備髓腔並置入股骨柄。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare the canal and insert the stem.
steps.instruction: 開髓偏外側，逐號擴髓至旋轉與軸向穩定（壓配）或留 2 mm 骨水泥鞘；前傾 10–15°。
steps.instructionEn: Enter laterally, broach sequentially to rotational and axial stability (press-fit) or leave a 2 mm cement mantle; anteversion 10–15°.
steps.observation: 檢查骨距有無裂痕。
steps.observationEn: Check the calcar for cracks.
steps.failure: 骨距裂痕需環紮固定，否則柄下沉。
steps.failureEn: A calcar crack needs cerclage or the stem subsides.
steps.check: 柄穩定、無骨折。
steps.checkEn: Stem stable without fracture.

knowledge.title: 聯合前傾
knowledge.textEn: Cup plus stem anteversion around 25–45°.

quiz.question: 「股骨髓腔準備與柄置入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Femoral preparation and stem insertion'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
切骨與計畫一致。
柄穩定、無骨折。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Cut matches the plan.
Stem stable without fracture.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 試復位、腿長與穩定性
steps.titleEn: Trial reduction, leg length and stability
steps.objective: 以試模確認腿長、偏距與穩定。
steps.objectiveEn: Trial for leg length, offset and stability.
steps.instruction: 試球頭復位後測試屈曲 90° 內旋 > 60° 不脫臼、伸直外旋穩定；比較兩側腿長與軟組織張力（shuck test）。
steps.instructionEn: Reduce with a trial head; test flexion 90° with internal rotation > 60° and extension–external rotation stability; compare leg lengths and soft-tissue tension (shuck test).
steps.observation: 記錄頸長選擇。
steps.observationEn: Record neck length selection.
steps.failure: 腿長差 > 1 cm 是常見訴訟原因。
steps.failureEn: Leg-length discrepancy > 1 cm is a common source of litigation.
steps.check: 穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
steps.checkEn: Stable with leg length within 5 mm.

knowledge.title: 雙動杯
knowledge.text: 高脫臼風險者的選擇。
knowledge.textEn: An option for high dislocation risk.

quiz.question: 「試復位、腿長與穩定性」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Trial reduction, leg length and stability'?
options: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
optionsEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 正式植入、關節囊修補與關閉
steps.titleEn: Definitive implantation, capsular repair and closure
steps.objective: 置入正式球頭與襯墊並修補後方結構。
steps.objectiveEn: Insert the definitive head and liner and repair posterior structures.
steps.instruction: 清潔錐度、擊入陶瓷或金屬球頭；修補後關節囊與短外旋肌至大轉子；逐層關閉。
steps.instructionEn: Clean the taper, impact the ceramic or metal head; repair posterior capsule and rotators to the trochanter; close in layers.
steps.observation: 確認復位與活動。
steps.observationEn: Confirm reduction and motion.
steps.failure: 錐度汙染導致磨損腐蝕（trunnionosis）。
steps.failureEn: Taper contamination causes trunnion corrosion.
steps.check: 關閉完成。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete.

knowledge.title: 後方修補
knowledge.text: 降低後外側入路的脫臼率。
knowledge.textEn: Reduces dislocation after the posterolateral approach.

quiz.question: 「正式植入、關節囊修補與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Definitive implantation, capsular repair and closure'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
關閉完成。
穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Closure complete.
Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
顯露完成。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
同意書與查核表完整。
optionsEn: Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Exposure complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Consent and checklist are complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 柄穩定、無骨折。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Stem stable without fracture.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出全人工髖關節置換的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Total hip arthroplasty and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
顯露完成。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Exposure complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
切骨與計畫一致。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
optionsEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Cut matches the plan.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
穩定且腿長在 5 mm 內。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Stable with leg length within 5 mm.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出全人工膝關節置換的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Total knee arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：機械軸對位、骨切量、軟組織平衡、髕骨處理與骨水泥固定。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Mechanical alignment, bone cuts, soft-tissue balancing, patellar management and cementation.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
試模穩定且軌跡良好。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Stable trial with good tracking.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
試模穩定且軌跡良好。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Stable trial with good tracking.
Components well fixed without remnants.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
同意書與查核表完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
切骨面平整、角度正確。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Flat cut at the correct angle.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依全人工膝關節置換的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Total knee arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 全人工膝關節置換的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Total knee arthroplasty.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 以內側髕旁入路顯露膝關節。
steps.objectiveEn: Expose the knee through a medial parapatellar approach.
steps.instruction: 正中切口，內側髕旁關節囊切開，外翻或半脫位髕骨，切除前後十字韌帶（CR 設計保留 PCL）與半月板，鬆解內側軟組織袖。
steps.instructionEn: Midline incision, medial parapatellar arthrotomy, evert/sublux the patella, resect ACL (and PCL unless cruciate-retaining) and menisci, release the medial soft-tissue sleeve.
steps.observation: 確認顯露足夠且髕韌帶止點無撕脫。
steps.observationEn: Confirm adequate exposure without patellar-tendon avulsion.
steps.failure: 髕韌帶撕脫是災難性併發症；僵硬膝需擴大鬆解。
steps.failureEn: Patellar-tendon avulsion is catastrophic; stiff knees need extended release.
steps.check: 顯露完成。
steps.checkEn: Exposure complete.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 內側髕旁最通用；midvastus／subvastus 保留股四頭肌。
knowledge.textEn: Medial parapatellar is most versatile; midvastus/subvastus spare the quadriceps.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 顯露完成。
伸直間隙矩形且平衡。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
optionsEn: Exposure complete.
Rectangular, balanced extension gap.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 遠端股骨切骨
steps.objective: 依機械軸垂直切除遠端股骨。
steps.objectiveEn: Cut the distal femur perpendicular to the mechanical axis.
steps.instruction: 髓內導桿（外翻角 5–6°）或導航／機器人設定；切除厚度等於植入物厚度（約 9–10 mm），依屈曲攣縮增減。
steps.instructionEn: Intramedullary rod (5–6° valgus) or navigation/robot; resection equals implant thickness (about 9–10 mm), adjusted for flexion contracture.
steps.observation: 以量尺核對切骨厚度。
steps.observationEn: Verify cut thickness with a gauge.
steps.failure: 切太多會抬高關節線並造成中段屈曲不穩。
steps.failureEn: Over-resection raises the joint line and causes mid-flexion instability.
steps.check: 切骨面平整、角度正確。
steps.checkEn: Flat cut at the correct angle.

knowledge.title: 對位哲學
knowledge.text: 機械軸對位 vs 運動學對位的取捨。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical versus kinematic alignment trade-offs.

quiz.question: 「遠端股骨切骨」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Distal femoral cut'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
切骨面平整、角度正確。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Flat cut at the correct angle.
Components well fixed without remnants.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 近端脛骨切骨
steps.objective: 垂直脛骨機械軸切除近端脛骨。
steps.objectiveEn: Cut the proximal tibia perpendicular to its mechanical axis.
steps.instruction: 髓外導桿對準踝中點，後傾 3–7°（依設計），自較低側切 2 mm 或較高側 8–10 mm。
steps.instructionEn: Extramedullary guide to the ankle centre, posterior slope 3–7° (by design), 2 mm below the deficient side or 8–10 mm below the intact side.
steps.observation: 以 spacer block 確認伸直間隙。
steps.observationEn: Check the extension gap with a spacer block.
steps.failure: 內翻切骨導致內側塌陷與早期鬆動。
steps.failureEn: A varus cut causes medial collapse and early loosening.
steps.check: 伸直間隙矩形且平衡。
steps.checkEn: Rectangular, balanced extension gap.

knowledge.title: 後傾
knowledge.text: CR 設計需較多後傾以保留 PCL 功能。
knowledge.textEn: Cruciate-retaining designs need more slope to preserve PCL function.

quiz.question: 「近端脛骨切骨」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Proximal tibial cut'?
options: 試模穩定且軌跡良好。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
屈伸間隙平衡、無 notching。
伸直間隙矩形且平衡。
optionsEn: Stable trial with good tracking.
Components well fixed without remnants.
Balanced gaps without notching.
Rectangular, balanced extension gap.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 股骨尺寸、旋轉與四合一切骨
steps.titleEn: Femoral sizing, rotation and the four-in-one cuts
steps.objective: 設定股骨元件尺寸與外旋。
steps.objectiveEn: Size the femoral component and set external rotation.
steps.instruction: 以後髁參考外旋 3°（或經上髁軸／Whiteside 線／間隙平衡），避免 notching；完成前、後與斜切。
steps.instructionEn: 3° external rotation to the posterior condyles (or epicondylar axis/Whiteside's line/gap balancing), avoid anterior notching; complete anterior, posterior and chamfer cuts.
steps.observation: 屈曲間隙與伸直間隙相等。
steps.observationEn: Flexion gap equals extension gap.
steps.failure: 內旋股骨元件造成髕骨軌跡不良與疼痛。
steps.failureEn: Internally rotated femoral components cause patellar maltracking and pain.
steps.check: 屈伸間隙平衡、無 notching。
steps.checkEn: Balanced gaps without notching.

knowledge.title: 間隙平衡
knowledge.text: 張力下的矩形屈曲間隙決定旋轉。
knowledge.textEn: A rectangular flexion gap under tension defines rotation.

quiz.question: 「股骨尺寸、旋轉與四合一切骨」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Femoral sizing, rotation and the four-in-one cuts'?
options: 屈伸間隙平衡、無 notching。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
切骨面平整、角度正確。
optionsEn: Balanced gaps without notching.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Components well fixed without remnants.
Flat cut at the correct angle.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 軟組織平衡與試模
steps.objective: 以試模檢查穩定度、活動度與髕骨軌跡。
steps.objectiveEn: Trial for stability, motion and patellar tracking.
steps.instruction: 逐步內側鬆解（內翻膝）或外側鬆解（外翻膝）；試模後檢查 0–120° 活動、內外翻穩定與 no-thumb 髕骨軌跡。
steps.instructionEn: Stepwise medial release (varus knee) or lateral release (valgus knee); after trialling check 0–120° motion, varus/valgus stability and 'no-thumb' patellar tracking.
steps.observation: 記錄襯墊厚度與鬆解程度。
steps.observationEn: Record insert thickness and releases.
steps.failure: 過度鬆解導致不穩；不足導致僵硬與疼痛。
steps.failureEn: Over-release causes instability; under-release stiffness and pain.
steps.check: 試模穩定且軌跡良好。
steps.checkEn: Stable trial with good tracking.

knowledge.title: 機器人與感測器
knowledge.text: 數位張力量測減少依賴手感。
knowledge.textEn: Digital tension measurement reduces reliance on feel.

quiz.question: 「軟組織平衡與試模」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Soft-tissue balancing and trialling'?
options: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
試模穩定且軌跡良好。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Stable trial with good tracking.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 骨水泥固定與植入
steps.objective: 以骨水泥固定正式元件。
steps.objectiveEn: Cement the definitive components.
steps.instruction: 脈衝沖洗乾燥骨面，骨水泥麵團期塗佈於骨與元件，依序脛骨→股骨→髕骨（若置換）加壓至固化；清除多餘骨水泥。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse-lavage and dry the bone; dough-phase cement on bone and implant; tibia → femur → patella (if resurfaced), hold under compression until set; remove excess cement.
steps.observation: 檢查後方殘留骨水泥。
steps.observationEn: Check for posterior cement remnants.
steps.failure: 骨水泥界面汙染血液會降低固定強度。
steps.failureEn: Blood contamination of the interface weakens fixation.
steps.check: 元件固定良好、無殘留。
steps.checkEn: Components well fixed without remnants.

knowledge.title: 非骨水泥設計
knowledge.text: 多孔金屬在年輕病人有良好骨長入。
knowledge.textEn: Porous metal shows good ingrowth in younger patients.

quiz.question: 「骨水泥固定與植入」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Cementation and implantation'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
切骨面平整、角度正確。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Flat cut at the correct angle.
Components well fixed without remnants.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
伸直間隙矩形且平衡。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Rectangular, balanced extension gap.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 屈伸間隙平衡、無 notching。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
伸直間隙矩形且平衡。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: Balanced gaps without notching.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Rectangular, balanced extension gap.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出全人工膝關節置換的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Total knee arthroplasty and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
試模穩定且軌跡良好。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
Stable trial with good tracking.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Outcomes and quality indicators'?
options: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
元件固定良好、無殘留。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
optionsEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
Components well fixed without remnants.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第一節 · 適應症與術前評估（免費試學）
stages.description: 本節免費：建立適應症、風險與同意的基礎。
stages.descriptionEn: Free section: indications, risk and consent.

steps.title: 適應症與禁忌
steps.objective: 列出單髁膝關節置換的主要適應症、相對與絕對禁忌。
steps.objectiveEn: List the main indications and the relative/absolute contraindications of Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 依教材與指引整理：內側單髁的適應症、活動襯墊與早期復原。
steps.instructionEn: Organise from the curriculum and guidelines: Medial UKA indications, mobile bearings and rapid recovery.
steps.observation: 記錄病人是否符合適應症、有無禁忌與替代方案。
steps.observationEn: Record whether the patient meets the indications, any contraindications and the alternatives.
steps.failure: 適應症不符時不應進行；若存在相對禁忌需多專科討論。
steps.failureEn: Do not proceed when indications are not met; relative contraindications require multidisciplinary discussion.
steps.check: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
steps.checkEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.

knowledge.title: 適應症的來源
knowledge.text: 適應症來自隨機試驗、指引與專家共識，會隨證據更新。
knowledge.textEn: Indications derive from trials, guidelines and consensus and change as evidence evolves.

knowledge.title: 共享決策
knowledge.text: 說明利益、風險與替代方案後，由病人參與決定。
knowledge.textEn: After explaining benefits, risks and alternatives, the patient participates in the decision.

quiz.question: 「適應症與禁忌」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Indications and contraindications'?
options: 能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 術前評估與風險分級
steps.objective: 完成病史、理學檢查、必要檢驗影像與風險分級。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete history, examination, required tests/imaging and risk scoring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對：心肺功能、凝血、用藥（抗凝／抗血小板）、過敏、影像與實驗室數據。
steps.instructionEn: Check item by item: cardiopulmonary status, coagulation, medications (anticoagulants/antiplatelets), allergies, imaging and laboratory data.
steps.observation: 整理成一頁術前摘要，標示高風險項目。
steps.observationEn: Compile a one-page pre-operative summary highlighting high-risk items.
steps.failure: 遺漏抗凝藥或未評估氣道是常見且可致命的疏失。
steps.failureEn: Missing an anticoagulant or an unassessed airway are common and potentially fatal omissions.
steps.check: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
steps.checkEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

knowledge.title: 風險工具
knowledge.text: ASA、RCRI 等工具提供結構化風險語言，但不取代臨床判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Tools such as ASA and RCRI give a structured risk language but do not replace judgement.

knowledge.title: 用藥調整
knowledge.text: 抗凝、降血糖與類固醇需依指引於術前調整。
knowledge.textEn: Anticoagulants, glucose-lowering drugs and steroids need guideline-based peri-operative adjustment.

quiz.question: 「術前評估與風險分級」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Pre-operative assessment and risk stratification'?
options: 術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）
steps.objective: 完成知情同意並進行 WHO 手術安全查核。
steps.objectiveEn: Obtain informed consent and run the WHO surgical safety checklist.
steps.instruction: 以病人聽得懂的語言說明步驟、風險、替代方案；手術前確認身份、部位、手術名稱與器材。
steps.instructionEn: Explain steps, risks and alternatives in plain language; before starting confirm identity, site, procedure and equipment.
steps.observation: 記錄同意書簽署與查核完成時間。
steps.observationEn: Record consent signature and checklist completion time.
steps.failure: 錯誤部位與錯誤病人是查核要避免的「永不事件」。
steps.failureEn: Wrong-site and wrong-patient events are 'never events' the checklist exists to prevent.
steps.check: 同意書與查核表完整。
steps.checkEn: Consent and checklist are complete.

knowledge.title: WHO 查核表三階段
knowledge.text: 麻醉前、劃刀前、離開手術室前。
knowledge.textEn: Before anaesthesia, before incision and before leaving the theatre.

knowledge.title: 病人自主
knowledge.text: 同意須自願、知情且具決定能力。
knowledge.textEn: Consent must be voluntary, informed and given with capacity.

quiz.question: 「知情同意與團隊簡報（Time-out）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Informed consent and team briefing (time-out)'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 麻醉、擺位與入路

steps.title: 麻醉與監測
steps.objective: 選擇麻醉方式並建立標準監測。
steps.objectiveEn: Choose the anaesthetic technique and establish standard monitoring.
steps.instruction: 與麻醉團隊確認：全身／區域麻醉、氣道計畫、血管通路與侵入性監測需求。
steps.instructionEn: Agree with the anaesthesia team: general/regional, airway plan, vascular access and invasive monitoring.
steps.observation: 記錄基礎生命徵象與麻醉計畫。
steps.observationEn: Record baseline vital signs and the anaesthetic plan.
steps.failure: 血流動力學不穩或氣道困難時先穩定再開始。
steps.failureEn: Stabilise haemodynamics or a difficult airway before starting.
steps.check: 監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
steps.checkEn: Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.

knowledge.title: 監測標準
knowledge.text: SpO2、EtCO2、心電圖、血壓與體溫為基本。
knowledge.textEn: SpO2, EtCO2, ECG, blood pressure and temperature are the minimum.

quiz.question: 「麻醉與監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Anaesthesia and monitoring'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
能正確區分適應症與禁忌並說明替代治療。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
Can correctly separate indications from contraindications and name alternatives.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 擺位、消毒與鋪單
steps.objective: 完成安全擺位、皮膚消毒與無菌鋪單。
steps.objectiveEn: Position safely, prepare the skin and drape sterilely.
steps.instruction: 保護壓點與神經，確認消毒範圍涵蓋可能延伸的切口。
steps.instructionEn: Pad pressure points and nerves; ensure the prepared field covers any extension of the incision.
steps.observation: 檢查眼睛保護、管路固定與四肢位置。
steps.observationEn: Check eye protection, line security and limb positions.
steps.failure: 擺位不當造成的神經壓迫與壓傷可在數小時內發生。
steps.failureEn: Positioning injuries to nerves and skin can occur within hours.
steps.check: 擺位安全、無菌區完整。
steps.checkEn: Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

knowledge.title: 無菌原則
knowledge.text: 從切口中心向外消毒，鋪單後不再觸碰非無菌區。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare from the incision outward; after draping never touch non-sterile areas.

quiz.question: 「擺位、消毒與鋪單」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Positioning, antisepsis and draping'?
options: 已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: 'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 入路與顯露
steps.objective: 依單髁膝關節置換的標準入路建立顯露。
steps.objectiveEn: Establish exposure through the standard approach for Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty.
steps.instruction: 逐層辨識解剖標誌，保護重要神經血管，使用適當牽開。
steps.instructionEn: Identify anatomical landmarks layer by layer, protect key neurovascular structures and retract appropriately.
steps.observation: 口述每一層所見結構並與解剖圖對照。
steps.observationEn: Name the structures in each layer and compare with the atlas.
steps.failure: 顯露不足時擴大切口優於盲目操作。
steps.failureEn: Extending the incision is safer than operating blind.
steps.check: 目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
steps.checkEn: The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.

knowledge.title: 入路選擇
knowledge.text: 入路取決於病灶位置、組織保護與術者經驗。
knowledge.textEn: The approach depends on lesion location, tissue preservation and surgeon experience.

quiz.question: 「入路與顯露」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Approach and exposure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
已正確完成「活動襯墊與早期復原」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第三節 · 核心步驟
stages.description: 單髁膝關節置換的關鍵操作要素。
stages.descriptionEn: The key operative elements of Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：內側單髁的適應症
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「內側單髁的適應症」在單髁膝關節置換中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Medial UKA indications' within Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「內側單髁的適應症」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'Medial UKA indications': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「內側單髁的適應症」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'Medial UKA indications'.
steps.failure: 若「內側單髁的適應症」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Medial UKA indications' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「內側單髁的適應症」是單髁膝關節置換的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Medial UKA indications' is a core component of Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：內側單髁的適應症」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Medial UKA indications'?
options: 同意書與查核表完整。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Consent and checklist are complete.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 關鍵要素 2：活動襯墊與早期復原
steps.titleEn: Key element 2: mobile bearings and rapid recovery
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「活動襯墊與早期復原」在單髁膝關節置換中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' within Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「活動襯墊與早期復原」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 觀察「活動襯墊與早期復原」完成後的解剖／生理變化並記錄。
steps.observationEn: Observe and record the anatomical/physiological change after 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery'.
steps.failure: 若「活動襯墊與早期復原」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「活動襯墊與早期復原」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「活動襯墊與早期復原」是單髁膝關節置換的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' is a core component of Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：活動襯墊與早期復原」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 2: mobile bearings and rapid recovery'?
options: 已正確完成「活動襯墊與早期復原」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
目標結構清楚顯露且周圍組織受保護。
optionsEn: 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
The target is clearly exposed with surrounding tissue protected.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 止血、檢查與關閉
steps.objective: 確認止血、器械紗布計數正確後逐層關閉。
steps.objectiveEn: Confirm haemostasis and correct instrument/sponge counts, then close in layers.
steps.instruction: 沖洗、檢查吻合或植入物位置、放置引流（如需）、關閉並記錄。
steps.instructionEn: Irrigate, check anastomoses or implant position, place drains if needed, close and document.
steps.observation: 記錄失血量、植入物序號與引流數量。
steps.observationEn: Record blood loss, implant serial numbers and drain count.
steps.failure: 計數不符時必須在關閉前以影像排除遺留。
steps.failureEn: A count discrepancy must be resolved by imaging before closure.
steps.check: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
steps.checkEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.

knowledge.title: 手術紀錄
knowledge.text: 紀錄應讓未在場者也能重建過程。
knowledge.textEn: The note should let someone absent reconstruct the procedure.

quiz.question: 「止血、檢查與關閉」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Haemostasis, final check and closure'?
options: 關閉完成、計數正確、紀錄完整。
已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
監測齊備且麻醉計畫與手術需求相符。
optionsEn: Closure complete, counts correct, documentation complete.
'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Monitoring is in place and the plan matches the surgical needs.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第四節 · 術後照護與併發症

steps.title: 術後監測
steps.objective: 建立術後觀察重點與警訊門檻。
steps.objectiveEn: Set post-operative observation priorities and alert thresholds.
steps.instruction: 依手術特性監測生命徵象、神經血管狀態、引流與疼痛。
steps.instructionEn: Monitor vital signs, neurovascular status, drains and pain according to the procedure.
steps.observation: 以表格記錄並標示異常趨勢。
steps.observationEn: Chart and flag abnormal trends.
steps.failure: 異常趨勢比單一數值更重要。
steps.failureEn: Trends matter more than single values.
steps.check: 監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
steps.checkEn: The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.

knowledge.title: 早期警訊
knowledge.text: NEWS2 等評分可標準化升級流程。
knowledge.textEn: Scores such as NEWS2 standardise escalation.

quiz.question: 「術後監測」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Post-operative monitoring'?
options: 已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
同意書與查核表完整。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
optionsEn: 'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Consent and checklist are complete.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 併發症辨識與處理
steps.objective: 列出單髁膝關節置換的常見與嚴重併發症及處理原則。
steps.objectiveEn: List the common and serious complications of Unicompartmental knee arthroplasty and the principles of management.
steps.instruction: 依時間軸（術中、早期、晚期）整理出血、感染、臟器損傷、血栓與裝置相關問題。
steps.instructionEn: Organise by timeline (intra-operative, early, late): bleeding, infection, organ injury, thrombosis and device-related problems.
steps.observation: 為每項併發症寫下偵測指標與第一步處置。
steps.observationEn: For each complication write the detection sign and first action.
steps.failure: 延遲辨識是併發症惡化的主因。
steps.failureEn: Delayed recognition is the main driver of deterioration.
steps.check: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
steps.checkEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.

knowledge.title: Clavien-Dindo 分級
knowledge.text: 以處置強度分級併發症，便於比較。
knowledge.textEn: Complications graded by the intensity of treatment required, enabling comparison.

quiz.question: 「併發症辨識與處理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Recognising and managing complications'?
options: 能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 出院、追蹤與復健
steps.objective: 制定出院標準、追蹤時程與復健計畫。
steps.objectiveEn: Define discharge criteria, follow-up schedule and rehabilitation.
steps.instruction: 包含傷口照護、活動限制、用藥、回診時間與警訊教育。
steps.instructionEn: Include wound care, activity limits, medications, review dates and warning-sign education.
steps.observation: 以書面衛教單確認病人理解。
steps.observationEn: Confirm understanding with a written leaflet and teach-back.
steps.failure: 缺乏衛教是再入院的常見原因。
steps.failureEn: Poor education is a common cause of readmission.
steps.check: 出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
steps.checkEn: The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.

knowledge.title: ERAS
knowledge.text: 早期進食、下床與多模式止痛縮短住院。
knowledge.textEn: Early feeding, mobilisation and multimodal analgesia shorten stays.

quiz.question: 「出院、追蹤與復健」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Discharge, follow-up and rehabilitation'?
options: 已正確完成「活動襯墊與早期復原」並以文字或數據留下證據。
監測計畫執行且異常能被及時發現。
出院計畫完整且病人能複述警訊。
術前摘要完整且風險分級有依據。
optionsEn: 'mobile bearings and rapid recovery' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
The monitoring plan is followed and abnormalities detected early.
The discharge plan is complete and the patient can repeat the warning signs.
The summary is complete and the risk grade is justified.

quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 結果評估與品質指標
steps.objective: 以結果指標評估手術品質。
steps.objectiveEn: Evaluate quality with outcome indicators.
steps.instruction: 整理死亡率、併發症率、再手術率、功能評分與病人報告結果（PROM）。
steps.instructionEn: Compile mortality, complication and reoperation rates, functional scores and patient-reported outcomes.
steps.observation: 與登錄資料或文獻基準比較。
steps.observationEn: Compare with registry data or literature benchmarks.
steps.failure: 沒有結果追蹤就無法改善。
steps.failureEn: Without outcome tracking there is no improvement.
steps.check: 能解釋至少三項品質指標。
steps.checkEn: Can explain at least three quality indicators.

knowledge.title: 登錄制度
knowledge.text: 國家級登錄（如關節置換登錄）揭露植入物長期表現。
knowledge.textEn: National registries (e.g. arthroplasty registries) reveal long-term implant performance.

quiz.question: 「結果評估與品質指標」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 已正確完成「內側單髁的適應症」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出至少五項併發症及其處理。
能解釋至少三項品質指標。
擺位安全、無菌區完整。
optionsEn: 'Medial UKA indications' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name at least five complications and their management.
Can explain at least three quality indicators.
Positioning is safe and the sterile field intact.

stages.title: 第一節 · 原理與適應症（免費試學）

steps.title: 原理與適應症
steps.objective: 說明機器人輔助關節置換的原理與適用情境。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain the principle and the situations where Robotic-assisted arthroplasty applies.
steps.instruction: 整理：CT 規劃、動態平衡與觸覺邊界切骨。
steps.instructionEn: Organise: CT planning, dynamic balancing and haptic boundary resection.
steps.observation: 以一張概念圖呈現輸入、過程與輸出。
steps.observationEn: Draw a one-page map of inputs, process and outputs.
steps.failure: 原理不清時操作會變成盲目模仿。
steps.failureEn: Without the principle, practice becomes blind imitation.
steps.check: 能用自己的話解釋原理與適用／不適用情境。
steps.checkEn: Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.

knowledge.title: 原理摘要
knowledge.text: CT 規劃、動態平衡與觸覺邊界切骨。
knowledge.textEn: CT planning, dynamic balancing and haptic boundary resection.

knowledge.title: 限制
knowledge.text: 每項技術都有偵測極限、偽影或偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: Every technique has detection limits, artefacts or sources of bias.

已正確完成「動態平衡與觸覺邊界切骨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
準備清單完成。

optionsEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'dynamic balancing and haptic boundary resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Preparation checklist complete.
Can explain the principle and when it does or does not apply in own words.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.title: 器材、環境與安全準備
steps.objective: 備妥器材、確認環境與安全措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Prepare equipment, check the environment and safety measures.
steps.instruction: 列出器材清單、校正／品管狀態、個人防護與病人（或樣本）準備。
steps.instructionEn: List equipment, calibration/QC status, PPE and patient (or sample) preparation.
steps.observation: 逐項打勾並記錄批號或校正日期。
steps.observationEn: Tick each item and record lot numbers or calibration dates.
steps.failure: 未校正的器材會產生看似合理的錯誤數據。
steps.failureEn: Uncalibrated equipment produces plausible but wrong data.
steps.check: 準備清單完成。
steps.checkEn: Preparation checklist complete.

knowledge.title: 品質管制
knowledge.text: 校正、對照與記錄是結果可信的前提。
knowledge.textEn: Calibration, controls and records underpin trustworthy results.

quiz.question: 「器材、環境與安全準備」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

Preparation checklist complete.

stages.title: 第二節 · 操作步驟
stages.description: 機器人輔助關節置換的操作要素。

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：CT 規劃
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「CT 規劃」在機器人輔助關節置換中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'CT planning' within Robotic-assisted arthroplasty, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 執行「CT 規劃」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Perform 'CT planning': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 記錄「CT 規劃」的設定、讀值或所見。
steps.observationEn: Record the settings, readings or findings of 'CT planning'.
steps.failure: 若「CT 規劃」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'CT planning' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「CT 規劃」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'CT planning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「CT 規劃」是機器人輔助關節置換的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'CT planning' is a core component of Robotic-assisted arthroplasty; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：CT 規劃」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

options: 準備清單完成。
已正確完成「CT 規劃」並以文字或數據留下證據。
能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
已正確完成「動態平衡與觸覺邊界切骨」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Preparation checklist complete.
'CT planning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can name three error sources and their prevention.
'dynamic balancing and haptic boundary resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。

steps.checkEn: 'dynamic balancing and haptic boundary resection' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

stages.title: 第三節 · 判讀、品質與安全

steps.title: 判讀與臨床決策
steps.objective: 將結果轉為臨床或研究結論。
steps.objectiveEn: Turn the result into a clinical or research conclusion.
steps.instruction: 對照參考範圍、前次結果與臨床情境，判斷是否需重複或進一步檢查。
steps.instructionEn: Compare with reference ranges, prior results and the clinical context; decide on repeat or further testing.

steps.observationEn: Write the interpretation sentence and the next step.
steps.failure: 脫離臨床情境的判讀容易誤判。
steps.failureEn: Interpretation detached from context misleads.
steps.check: 判讀有依據且下一步明確。
steps.checkEn: The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.

knowledge.title: 前測機率
knowledge.text: 檢查結果的意義取決於做檢查前的機率。

The interpretation is justified and the next step defined.
'CT planning' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

steps.failureEn: Most errors occur before and after, not during, the procedure.
steps.check: 能說出三項錯誤來源與預防方法。
steps.checkEn: Can name three error sources and their prevention.

knowledge.title: 通報文化
knowledge.text: 無責難通報促進系統改善。

quiz.question: 「品質、錯誤與安全回顧」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

stages.title: 第一節 · 機制與病理生理（免費試學）

steps.title: 機制與病理生理
steps.objective: 掌握功能性／運動學對位的背景與基本機制。
steps.objectiveEn: Grasp the background and basic mechanism of Kinematic and functional alignment.
steps.instruction: 閱讀並整理：與機械軸對位的差異、冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）。
steps.instructionEn: Read and organise: Differences from mechanical alignment and CPAK phenotypes.
steps.observation: 以流程圖畫出因果鏈。
steps.observationEn: Draw the causal chain as a flow diagram.
steps.failure: 把相關性誤認為因果是最常見的推理錯誤。
steps.failureEn: Mistaking correlation for causation is the most common reasoning error.
steps.check: 能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
steps.checkEn: Can draw and explain the causal chain.

knowledge.title: 核心摘要
knowledge.text: 與機械軸對位的差異、冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）。
knowledge.textEn: Differences from mechanical alignment and CPAK phenotypes.

knowledge.title: 術語
knowledge.text: 先定義名詞，再討論機制。
knowledge.textEn: Define terms before discussing mechanisms.

quiz.question: 「機制與病理生理」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

steps.observationEn: Complete the glossary.

steps.check: 名詞表完整且分類合理。
steps.checkEn: Glossary complete and classification sound.

knowledge.title: 分類的目的

knowledge.textEn: Classification should serve treatment decisions or prognosis.

quiz.question: 「關鍵名詞與分類」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？

名詞表完整且分類合理。
已正確完成「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: 'Differences from mechanical alignment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
Glossary complete and classification sound.
'CPAK phenotypes' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

stages.title: 第二節 · 臨床表現與診斷

steps.title: 關鍵要素 1：與機械軸對位的差異
steps.titleEn: Key element 1: Differences from mechanical alignment
steps.objective: 能說明並執行「與機械軸對位的差異」在功能性／運動學對位中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'Differences from mechanical alignment' within Kinematic and functional alignment, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「與機械軸對位的差異」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'Differences from mechanical alignment': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「與機械軸對位的差異」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'Differences from mechanical alignment'.
steps.failure: 若「與機械軸對位的差異」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'Differences from mechanical alignment' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「與機械軸對位的差異」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'Differences from mechanical alignment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「與機械軸對位的差異」是功能性／運動學對位的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'Differences from mechanical alignment' is a core component of Kinematic and functional alignment; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 1：與機械軸對位的差異」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement is the acceptance check for 'Key element 1: Differences from mechanical alignment'?
options: 病例推理完整。
總結涵蓋治療、證據與限制。
能畫出並解釋因果鏈。
已正確完成「與機械軸對位的差異」並以文字或數據留下證據。
optionsEn: Case reasoning complete.
The summary covers treatment, evidence and limits.
Can draw and explain the causal chain.
'Differences from mechanical alignment' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.
quiz.explanation: 驗收標準來自本步驟的目標；其他選項屬於其他步驟。
quiz.explanationEn: The check derives from this step's objective; the other options belong to other steps.

steps.objective: 能說明並執行「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」在功能性／運動學對位中的作用與順序。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain and perform 'CPAK phenotypes' within Kinematic and functional alignment, in sequence.
steps.instruction: 分析「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」：先複述目的，再示範操作或推理，最後記錄觀察。
steps.instructionEn: Analyse 'CPAK phenotypes': restate the purpose, demonstrate the action or reasoning, then record observations.
steps.observation: 整理「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」的表現、證據或判別要點。
steps.observationEn: Summarise the presentation, evidence or distinguishing points of 'CPAK phenotypes'.
steps.failure: 若「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」無法完成或結果異常，先回到上一要素確認前提，再檢查操作條件；不可跳步。
steps.failureEn: If 'CPAK phenotypes' cannot be completed or gives an abnormal result, re-verify the previous element and the operating conditions; never skip ahead.
steps.check: 已正確完成「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」並以文字或數據留下證據。
steps.checkEn: 'CPAK phenotypes' has been completed correctly with written or numeric evidence.

knowledge.title: 要素的作用
knowledge.text: 「冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」是功能性／運動學對位的核心組成，其結果影響後續步驟的安全與效果。
knowledge.textEn: 'CPAK phenotypes' is a core component of Kinematic and functional alignment; its outcome determines the safety and effect of later steps.

knowledge.title: 常見錯誤
knowledge.text: 順序錯置、條件未確認與未記錄數據是最常見的三種失誤。
knowledge.textEn: Wrong sequence, unverified conditions and missing records are the three most common errors.

quiz.question: 「關鍵要素 2：冠狀面對位表型（CPAK）」這一步的驗收標準是哪一項？
